Nebraska Revised Statute §32-941                                                        Updated January 2026                                                                       Page 1

NOTICE
I, Dawn Hill, Gage County Clerk/Election Commissioner, hereby give notice of the offices to be filled by election that will appear
on the 2026 General Election Ballot in Gage County, Nebraska. Notice is also given that the filing deadlines for such offices are:
July 15, 2026 at 5:00 o'clock p.m. for incumbents and August 3, 2026 at 5:00 o'clock p.m. for non-incumbents. An incumbent is
anyone serving in an elective office, even if they are filing for an office other than the one in which they are presently serving,
and, therefore, they would be required to file by 5:00 p.m. on July 15, 2026.

Dated this 17th day of June, 2026                                           Dawn Hill, Gage County Clerk/Election Commissioner
